unit.why: A hearsay-and-eyewitness account of R. Nahman of Breslov's journey to the Land of Israel is followed by a separate account of his death the next year.
unit.boundary_note: The two narratives are only loosely joined; a short passage about R. Mendel of Przemyślany ('ונלוו׳ ר׳ מענדלי... ותמה מאוד על חכמת הבעש״ט') is fragmentary and unclear.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מהרב דקהלתינו כשרצה ר׳ נחמן
stories.summary_en: Before travelling to the Land of Israel, R. Nahman visits the Besht's grave, says with joy that the Besht appeared and commanded the journey, then spends a Shabbat with the Mokhiah, quarrels with him, teaches on subtle alien thoughts, and is escorted out of town, where they pray Minhah in a field.

tags.why: Visits the Besht's grave before the journey.

tags.why: The Land of Israel is the destination of the journey.

stories.start_quote: ולשנה אחרת מת רב נחמן ז"ל
stories.summary_en: R. Nahman dies in Tammuz on a Shabbat: he makes Kiddush and drinks wine in his Sabbath clothes, is found dying during the meal, studies the Zohar as his soul departs, and dies at Minhah.

tags.why: A deathbed scene of R. Nahman.

His death is timed to the Minhah prayer.
